recommendations.regimenLabel: IV thyroid hormone + hydrocortisone cover + supportive ICU care
steps: ICU; IV levothyroxine (± liothyronine) — give thyroid hormone.
Give IV HYDROCORTISONE first/concurrently (until adrenal insufficiency excluded).
Passive rewarming, ventilatory support for hypoventilation/CO2 retention.
Cautious correction of hyponatraemia and hypoglycaemia; IV fluids.
Treat the precipitant (commonly infection — may be afebrile).

drugRefs.why: Give before/with thyroid hormone until coexisting adrenal insufficiency is excluded — thyroid replacement alone can precipitate adrenal crisis.
Replaces thyroid hormone in myxoedema coma; switch to oral once stable and absorbing.

drugRefs.dose: 5–20 mcg loading, then 2.5–10 mcg every 8 h
drugRefs.why: Added in severe/refractory coma or where peripheral T4→T3 conversion is impaired; use cautiously (cardiac risk).

refs: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 22e — Hypothyroidism / Myxoedema Coma
American Thyroid Association Guidelines for Treatment of Hypothyroidism

confirm: Severe hypothyroidism with hypothermia, bradycardia, hypoventilation and reduced consciousness ± hyponatraemia; usually a precipitant.
